caption: The drawing depicts two oval-shaped bottles, each with a short cylindrical neck and a narrow mouth, rendered in shades of light blue-green. The bottles are positioned side by side on a neutral, off-white background; the one on the left shows its front and the one on the right displays its reverse side. The bottle on the left features the raised profile of a human figure facing right, with detailed facial features and hair, encircled by an ornamental border. The bottle on the right bears a raised image of a bird, likely an eagle, with outstretched wings and a radiating halo or rays behind its head, also surrounded by a decorative border. Both bottles have similar shapes and appear translucent, with subtle shading indicating their three-dimensional form. In the lower right corner of the image, the artist’s signature “V. L. Vance” is present.
title: Washington Eagle Flask
